Sunny Milk
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 11:26pm

Ingredients




1 quart Water, ice cold
1 cup Sunflower seeds
cup Ripe banana (opt)
1 tablespoon Sorghum OR
3 tablespoons Raisins

Preparation

1 Put all ingredients in a blender, and blend at high speed for 2 minutes. 2 Serve as a drink or over granola. Add banana for a thicker milk. Good on breakfast cereal. 3 VARIATION: soak seeds overnight, then blend.
